title: mspaintcraft
description: replaces all textures with those drawn in ms paint, bitcrushes all sounds and replaces all (non-music disk) songs with ncs songs
body:
(play with the lolcat language for best experience)

this pack replaces all stuff (well, almost all stuff i cant be bothered redoing unicode letters) with those drawn in ms paint, makes all sound effects low quality, and replaces all ambience songs with those published by ncs
